course_title: Econometrics with AI and Machine Learning
course_description: This course explores advanced econometric techniques with a focus on machine learning (ML)based methods and their applications to large datasets using R programming. Topics include the bias-variance trade-off, regression, classification, nearest neighbour algorithm, cross-validation, model selection, regularised estimation, bagging & random forests, deep neural networks, convolutional and recurrent neural networks, text embeddings, attention, transformers, and large language models. The R language will be used in class for illustration. You are welcome to use Python if you wish to.
course_summary:
- Advanced econometric techniques with a focus on machine learning.
- Applications to large datasets using R programming.
- Topics include regression, classification, cross-validation, and model selection.
learning_outcomes:
- Explore the bias-variance trade-off and regularised estimation.
- Utilize R and Python for econometric applications.
- Understand and apply machine learning methods such as random forests, deep neural networks, and large language models.
what_you_will_learn:
- Bias-variance trade-off in econometrics.
- Implementation of ML methods using R and Python.
- Advanced machine learning techniques like deep learning and transformers.

schedule_of_topics.topic_name: Overview; linear algebra basics; programming in R.
Model selection and regularisation (Ch. 6); programming in R.

policies.summary: Students requiring accommodations should inform the instructor by the third week of the semester. Collaboration with the McBurney Centre ensures accessibility.
Academic misconduct, including plagiarism or cheating, is prohibited. Penalties include course removal and Dean notification.
Confidential resources are available via University Health Services and Violence Prevention Services.
UW-Madison values diversity and inclusivity. For more information, refer to the Diversity and Inclusion Policy.
Notify the instructor within the first two weeks if you have conflicts due to religious observances.
